<ParamField body="checked" type="boolean">
  Whether the switch is currently active.

  To render an uncontrolled switch, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode" required>
  Visible label and default accessible name of the switch. Use non-interactive node content.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string | ((state: SwitchRootState) =&gt; string | undefined)">
  Customizes the visible Switch root and accepts a Switch state callback.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultChecked" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the switch is initially active.

  To render a controlled switch, use the `checked` prop instead.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="description" type="ReactNode">
  Non-interactive supporting node content, used as the default accessible description of the switch.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="focused" type="boolean" default="false">
  Applies the highlighted row style without moving keyboard focus.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="form" type="string">
  Identifies the form that owns the hidden input.
  Useful when the switch is rendered outside the form.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="id" type="string">
  Identifies the associated checkbox, or the visible root with nativeButton. The label association follows this ID.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="inputRef" type="Ref&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="labelRef" type="Ref&lt;HTMLLabelElement&gt;">

<ParamField body="labelRender" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Customizes the outer native label with its complete composed row children. Preserve a label element and forward its props to retain control association.

<ParamField body="name" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="nativeButton" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
  via the `render` prop.
  Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onCheckedChange" type="((checked: boolean, eventDetails: { reason: &quot;none&quot;; event: Event; cancel: () =&gt; void; allowPropagation: () =&gt; void; isCanceled: boolean; isPropagationAllowed: boolean; trigger: Element | undefined; }) =&gt; void)">

<ParamField body="uncheckedValue" type="string">
  The value submitted with the form when the switch is off.
